import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

def fetch_arxiv_page(start=0):
    # Use %20 for spaces to avoid control-character issues
    query = 'all:multimodal%20OR%20all:RAG'
    url = f'http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query={query}&start={start}&max_results=25&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending'
    return web_fetch(url=url)

# XML namespace used by arXiv
NS = {'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'}

def is_multimodal_rag_paper(title, summary):
    text = f"{title} {summary}".lower()
    multimodal_keywords = [
        'multimodal', 'vision', 'visual', 'image', 'video', 'audio',
        'speech', 'cross-modal', 'crossmodal', 'vlm', 'vision-language',
        'vision language', 'graph', 'document', 'table', 'chart'
    ]
    rag_keywords = ['rag', 'retrieval-augmented', 'retrieval augmented']
    has_multimodal = any(kw in text for kw in multimodal_keywords)
    has_rag = any(kw in text for kw in rag_keywords)
    return has_multimodal and has_rag

papers = []
page_start = 0
max_pages = 10  # safety limit

while len(papers) < 5 and page_start < max_pages * 25:
    resp = fetch_arxiv_page(page_start)
    if resp.get('status') != 200:
        print(f'Failed to fetch page starting at {page_start}')
        break
    root = ET.fromstring(resp['content'])
    for entry in root.findall('atom:entry', NS):
        title_el = entry.find('atom:title', NS)
        summary_el = entry.find('atom:summary', NS)
        updated_el = entry.find('atom:updated', NS)
        id_el = entry.find('atom:id', NS)
        # Get the HTML link (alternate)
        link_el = None
        for link in entry.findall('atom:link', NS):
            if link.get('rel') == 'alternate' and link.get('type') == 'text/html':
                link_el = link.get('href')
                break
        if None in (title_el, summary_el, updated_el, id_el, link_el):
            continue
        title = title_el.text.strip()
        summary = ' '.join(summary_el.text.strip().split())
        updated = updated_el.text.strip()[:10]  # YYYY-MM-DD
        arxiv_id = id_el.text.strip()
        if is_multimodal_rag_paper(title, summary):
            papers.append({
                'title': title,
                'summary': summary,
                'date': updated,
                'link': link_el
            })
            if len(papers) >= 5:
                break
    page_start += 25

# Build markdown table
def escape_pipe(s):
    return s.replace('|', '\\|')

def build_markdown_table(papers):
    header = "| Rank | Title | Date | Summary (truncated) | Link |\n"
    separator = "|------|-------|------|---------------------|------|\n"
    rows = []
    for i, p in enumerate(papers[:5], 1):
        clean_sum = ' '.join(p['summary'].split())[:150]
        safe_title = escape_pipe(p['title'])
        safe_sum = escape_pipe(clean_sum)
        rows.append(f"| {i} | {safe_title} | {p['date']} | {safe_sum} | [{p['link']}]({p['link']}) |")
    return header + separator + "\n".join(rows)

markdown_content = build_markdown_table(papers)

with open('papers.md', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(markdown_content)

print(f'Successfully wrote {len(papers)} multimodal RAG papers to papers.md')
finish(summary='Collected 5 recent multimodal RAG papers from arXiv and wrote a comparison table to papers.md')
